evidenceIntakeCandidates.surface: ElevenLabs overview / TTS, with API and UI links separated
evidenceIntakeCandidates.sourceMeaning: TTS generates spoken audio; listed v3, Multilingual v2 and Flash v2.5 differ in language and character limits; output can vary.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.limitation: Model-specific limits and API voice-library access do not establish every UI voice or every plan entitlement.

evidenceIntakeCandidates.sourceMeaning: All users may use Voice Design; Instant Voice Cloning starts at Starter with permission; Professional Voice Cloning starts at Creator for one's own voice.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.limitation: Voice Design, IVC, PVC and community voices are distinct; permission is not supplied by plan purchase.

evidenceIntakeCandidates.surface: ElevenLabs voice cloning concept / API docs
evidenceIntakeCandidates.sourceMeaning: IVC and PVC include verification, but verification cannot guarantee that the supplied recording belongs to the requester.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.limitation: A verification step is no proof that the user owns voice or distribution rights.

evidenceIntakeCandidates.sourceMeaning: Free use is non-commercial; paid-plan commercial use remains subject to the terms and prohibited-use policy.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.limitation: Region-specific terms and rights in script, recordings and identity require separate review; no blanket commercial clone license.

evidenceIntakeCandidates.sourceMeaning: Generated audio can be downloaded immediately or from history; history offers MP3, WAV, M4A and FLAC choices.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.limitation: This is rendered audio download, not a portable voice model or API entitlement.

evidenceIntakeCandidates.sourceMeaning: Default output is MP3; endpoint documentation lists Creator+ for 192 kbps MP3 and Pro+ for 44.1 kHz PCM/WAV.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.limitation: API-only claim. Current pricing page places high-quality audio under Pro, so 192 kbps API tier is conflict-pending and must not become a verified entitlement claim.

evidenceIntakeCandidates.sourceMeaning: Free has TTS and 10k monthly credits; Starter has commercial license, IVC and 30k; Creator has PVC and 121k; Pro lists 44.1 kHz PCM API and 192 kbps quality.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.limitation: Shared credits and model/channel cost vary; pricing is not a guarantee of usable minutes or a target-account API format.

evidenceIntakeCandidates.sourceMeaning: A voice clone cannot be downloaded as a standalone file; it remains in the account and may be used through ElevenLabs API calls.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.limitation: Do not conflate rendered audio export with model export.

evidenceIntakeCandidates.sourceMeaning: Script-to-speech supports stock or custom speakers, selected Multilingual v2, ElevenLabs v3 or v4 models and multi-speaker sections.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.limitation: Listed TTS languages do not establish dubbing languages or every voice/model pairing; timeline edits require conversion to a standard audio layer.

evidenceIntakeCandidates.sourceMeaning: Stock voices use the ElevenLabs Voice Library; community voice availability can change and matching voice language to script is recommended.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.limitation: Presence in library does not establish a per-voice commercial license or long-term availability.

evidenceIntakeCandidates.sourceMeaning: A custom voice requires recorded authorization from the speaker, in English, including third-party speakers; deceased, non-consenting, unable-to-record and synthetic source voices are excluded.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.limitation: Authorization workflow does not independently prove scope of commercial distribution rights.

evidenceIntakeCandidates.surface: Descript service terms / generated output and AI Speakers
evidenceIntakeCandidates.sourceMeaning: Input/output rights are allocated to the user only to the extent protectable by law; the user must vet generated output and obtain speaker permission.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.limitation: This is not a direct stock/custom voice commercial-use license matrix.

evidenceIntakeCandidates.sourceMeaning: The editor exports compositions or selections locally as MP3, WAV or M4A with audio settings.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.limitation: UI local export does not prove an equivalent direct API download route or per-plan entitlement.

evidenceIntakeCandidates.sourceMeaning: The API can obtain signed rendered file URLs after publishing a Descript web link; direct rendered audio download without publishing is unsupported.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.limitation: API publishing is a separate workflow from editor local export.

evidenceIntakeCandidates.sourceMeaning: Free AI Speech and custom clones are limited; Hobbyist, Creator and Business list 400, 800 and 1500 monthly AI credits per editor respectively.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.limitation: The table does not establish a complete consent/export entitlement by plan; Free AI credits are shown separately as one-time in the comparison.

evidenceIntakeCandidates.sourceMeaning: Media minutes and AI credits are separate shared Drive pools; unused allowances do not roll over; Editor role is required for metered features; TTS cost varies with length and model.
evidenceIntakeCandidates.limitation: No fixed credits-per-delivered-minute claim; legacy plans may differ.
